title: Review finding
description: A single annotated defect in one code snippet.

id.description: Stable identifier. The numeric part matches the snippet filename.

snippet.description: Repository-relative path to the code under review.

title.description: The defect in one line, stated as a claim rather than a question.

severity.description: Defined in ANNOTATION_GUIDE.md. Reflects blast radius and detectability, not fix difficulty.

defect_lines.description: 1-indexed lines in the snippet a reviewer would point at.

explanation.description: The mechanism. Why the language behaves this way, not just that it does.

trigger.description: A concrete input, state, or interleaving that produces the failure.

observed.description: What the code actually produces for the trigger.

expected.description: What the surrounding code plainly intends.

fix.description: Corrected code. A fragment is acceptable if the change is local.

fix_rationale.description: Why this fix, and what it deliberately leaves unaddressed.

distractors.description: Nearby code that looks suspicious but is correct as written.

references.description: Primary sources: language reference, PEP, TC39, or standard library docs.
